loss_audit.interpretation: Source-reviewed supported bindings and historical annotated-line hits measure different things; report both. Restoring the fixed-chunk binding returns an existing old supported binding, not a new discovery over V7.

limits: All sources and old judgments were exposed during development; this is a regression audit, not independent efficacy evidence.
Counts are binding occurrences and must not be presented as distinct bug tasks or mechanisms.
The fresh fixed-chunk judgment changes the consistently graded old baseline from eight to nine supported bindings; use nine for both old and current comparisons.
Old ungraded bindings remain unknown. Current contradicted proposals remain numerous, and reduced return volume contributes to pruning.
